question:
Architecture ramp design with $\tan\theta=x/h$, $h=6$, and $\theta\in[0,\pi/3]$.

(a) Express $x$ in terms of $\theta$.

(b) Find maximum allowable $x$.

(c) Determine where $f(\theta)=\cos(\sec^{-1}(1+\tan\theta))$ is maximized.
explanation:
(a) $x=6\tan\theta$. Since $\theta\in[0,\pi/3]$, $x\in[0,6\sqrt3]$.

(b) Maximum occurs at $\theta=\pi/3$: $x=6\sqrt3\approx10.392$.

(c) Using identity $\cos(\sec^{-1}y)=1/y$, $f(\theta)=1/(1+\tan\theta)$.

Maximum occurs when $\tan\theta$ is minimum, i.e. $\theta=0$.
